blurb: Guests can paddle scenic waters by canoe or kayak, cast fishing lines, snorkel riverbeds, swim, hike, bike, create art, and explore guided ecology and history tours. They offer full-day self-guided rentals and various guided paddle events including moonlight paddles, art and ecology series, and special ceremonies. Camping under the stars along the riverway is also available.
